page.notes: Long s throughout is plain s (e.g. "esse" printed with long-s double letters as "effe"). The signature mark at the foot reads "(:) s" and is uncertain. The catchword "tegrè" is printed as the start of the next page's word "integrè"; kept as printed. The word "circuli" is broken between lines without a printed hyphen and is written whole. "inhoc" is printed as one word and is kept as printed. The word "titulorū" keeps its macron as printed.
